title: Learning Treatment Allocations with Risk Control Under Partial Identifiability

split.decision: Original 100 repetitions, seed 10603+i, retain 2109 learning / 1054 certification / 1055 evaluation rows from 4218 preprocessed STAR students. All real rows remain private. Fresh fit and certification sandboxes per repetition; immutable FFT candidates before certification. Public validation is the real International Stroke Trial data of the paper's Appendix A.5, disjoint from STAR and public including labels: 18298 patients, 53 covariate columns encoding the paper's 23 covariates, 40 repetitions with seed 10603+i and 9149/4574/4575 rows, tau=.225, gamma=1, propensity=.5. Its score is a guide to method progress, not an estimate of STAR performance.

baseline.paper_ref: Released 40-bin STAR configuration; no fresh converted reference measured.
baseline.runtime_note: Fitting executes during private score replay; no full runtime measurement.

allowed_changes: Search over the same policy class, auxiliary policy-learning loss, optimizers, lookahead/search strategy and valid risk certification methods may change.
The baseline greedy tree builder and lambda search grid do not fix the solver; training-derived split thresholds must retain the selected feature/class definition.
Changing only `lookahead`, `lambda_range` or `lambda_n` in `code/adapter.py` does not count as a method change (patch audit).
fixed_contract: Minimize certified STAR population risk at tau=.35 within the original interpretable fast-and-frugal policy class.
The STAR outcomes/treatment meaning, original preprocessed covariates, policy-learning/certification/evaluation roles and 100-replication aggregation remain fixed.
One fast-and-frugal policy per replication, at most three single-variable split conditions and the selected 40-bin threshold grid define the scientific policy class.
Gamma1, propensity.5, released inverse-propensity population/treatment-risk estimators, coverage>=.90 and mean treatment risk<=.35 remain fixed, including the recorded zero-loss edge cases.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.

The tree search objective keeps its penalty of 0.02 per split (`loss_i + 0.02 * n` in `method/create_fft_constraint.py`): do not change, tune, schedule or remove it, and do not offset it by rescaling the loss it is added to.
Any search or auxiliary loss that generates candidate trees keeps the same 0.02 per split in its objective; committing trees from an objective without it counts as removing the penalty (patch audit).
The certification confidence stays at 90% (`self.delta = 0.1` in `code/method/weights_p_bound.py`); a replacement bound must hold at that level (patch audit).
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not substitute unrestricted neural policies, forests, deeper rules, oblique conditions or another threshold grid, change causal estimands/propensities, or use alternative outcome labels.
No fitting on certification/evaluation outcomes, cross-repetition state, external STAR data or release of overlapping real development records.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
method_freedom_review.certification_validity: Selection among precommitted candidates enforced; statistical validity of replacement certification methods remains subject to method review.

evidence.finding: Research optimization is over interpretable policies; experiments select fast-and-frugal trees with single-variable gridded conditions, while greedy fitting is a method.
Selected STAR configuration fixes n_splits3, n_bins40 and 100 independent partition experiments.
Defines original single-feature quantile threshold grid and maximum split depth.
Selected user-decision metric explicitly refers to the released 40-bin STAR configuration.
Audited statistical metric exists but CSV-only validity cannot enforce policy structure or information isolation.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

leakage_remediation.private_execution: Fresh fit and certification sandboxes for every repetition; only learning rows can create tree candidates; only existing candidate index can be selected; evaluation decisions reconstructed by trusted scorer. Empty resources, redacted errors.
leakage_remediation.source_history: Fresh method-only sanitized snapshot, no upstream Git objects/data/results.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
